page.overview:
Who is Penelope Clearwater?

Penelope 'Penny' Clearwater (born c. 1975 or 1976) was a witch and Ravenclaw student at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry from 1987 to 1994. In her later school years, she was a prefect, and eventually started dating Percy Weasley, a Gryffindor student and a fellow prefect.

Penelope was born in 1975 or 1976 in Great Britain or Ireland. She was either from a Muggle family or had both Muggle and magical heritage.

Penelope Clearwater arrived at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in 1987 and upon her arrival was Sorted into Ravenclaw house.
